verses.26:149: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتࣰ ا فَٰرِهِينَ

meaning: The root فره (frh) describes skill, briskness, and beauty. A "fārih" person is skillful, while a "fārih" animal (like a mule or ass) is lively and strong.
